title.zh: 小波 · 让窗口随频率伸缩
title.en: Wavelets · Windows That Stretch With Frequency

desc.zh: 傅里叶谱说得出「有哪些频率」，说不出「何时」。从加窗口、到让窗口随频率伸缩，再到用最少的数描述突变。
desc.en: A Fourier spectrum says which frequencies are present, but not when. Add a window, let the window stretch with frequency, then describe sharp changes with very few numbers.
